name: $AVGO Observer

tweets.text: 这个角度挺关键：TPU对外卖，抢的是新增订单，短期动不了NVDA的基本盘。但对AVGO来说，不管TPU走内部还是对外，不少自研芯片都要经过它。周一收$313.55，仍在20日均线$331.60之下，12月9日财报前还是先看需求能不能兑现。

Scale-up past the rack is where the switch matters as much as the accelerator. Single-hop Ethernet at 500-1k GPUs is Tomahawk/Jericho territory, and the copper-vs-optics split in this model is the number to watch.
NVDA 一天 +31%，AVGO 只跟了 3%，盘中还从 $324.46 回到 $313.55。 这轮反弹是黄仁勋复任带起来的，NVDA 自己的事，没扩散到整个 AI 硬件。AVGO 仍在三条均线下方，砍单传闻两边都没回应，答案得等 12/9 财报。 $AVGO

16x looks cheap next to the rest of the list, but the multiple is doing a lot of work here. AVGO closed Monday at $313.55, still under its 20-day at $331.60 with RSI at 43.8. Dec 9 earnings should say more than the P/E does.

Agree on the direction. Google spreading custom silicon across vendors fits what we've seen, and Broadcom's scale and track record with Google still count for a lot. v10 is a long way out though, so Dec 9 earnings will tell us more about the mix.
周五那波 -12.2% 之后，两边到现在还没达成共识：期权那边还是防御姿态，看跌溢价 $343M，看涨 $195.6M；另一边抄底的声量一点没减，观察名单里 AVGO 直接排第一。感恩节这周量又淡，波动估计小不了。$AVGO

This is the other side of Friday's selloff. Every hyperscaler said the same thing in Q3, demand still ahead of supply, and FY2027 CapEx plans haven't moved. A mix shift at one customer isn't the whole budget shrinking. $AVGO

€86M in cash deposits against ~$1.2B of reservations is the part that stands out. That is committed demand, not a forecast, and with CPO starting in CY27 the co-packaged switch sits right at the center of it.
砍单砍的是 TPU，机架里的交换芯片不在此列。AInvest 的看法是，Google 削减的是定制 XPU 那端，博通的以太网组网（Tomahawk Ultra 这类）没在削减范围里。Hock Tan 说组网长期占 AI 收入 30–40%，Q3 只有 27%。周五 AVGO 跌了 12.2%，组网这块到底有没有被错杀，12/9 财报见分晓。$AVGO

The middle tier is where $AVGO sits at ~160bps. Not the stressed end of the chart, but financing commitments keep growing, and Friday's -12.2% close shows how quickly the market reprices that risk. Credit is becoming part of the AI story.
